sloka: सा त्वशोकस्य विपुलां शाखामालम्ब्य पुष्पिताम् ।चिन्तयामास शोकेन भर्तारं भग्नमानसा ।। ५.२३.६।।।।
transliteration: sā tvaśokasya vipulāṁ śākhāmālambya puṣpitām ।cintayāmāsa śokena bhartāraṁ bhagnamānasā ।। 5.23.6।।।।

translations.english: 'The mindborn son of Brahma is well known as Paulastya. He was the fourth among the six Prajapatis (Maricha, Atri, Angira, Pulastya, Plaha, Kratu).
